observableChecks: At least one contract covers explicit normalization of user-supplied dependency change records.
At least one negative activation region excludes dependency advice, vulnerability review, upgrade planning, or package installation.
Required effects preserve supplied package and version values, sort valid records by package, preserve duplicate-package input order, and separate incomplete records.
Prohibited effects include invented or normalized versions and compatibility, security, licensing, priority, or upgrade recommendations.
Responsibility boundaries prohibit manifests, lockfiles, registries, advisories, release notes, external state, and package-manager execution.
Blocking unresolved requirements preserve absent decision thresholds, target usage distribution, severe-harm limits, or required uncertainty rather than inventing them.
Every identifier is derived from observable authored content rather than hidden expected state.
terminalFailureConditions: Missing observable contract or activation boundary
